== Update April 22, 2026 == Today, Guild Wars begins our celebration of 21 years of skill exploration, collection, and camaraderie in the lands of Tyria, Cantha and Elona. {{quote|What's in a name? That which we call a rose
By any other word would smell as sweet.}} William Shakespeare, Romeo and Juliet, Act 2, Scene 2 * With today's build we have relaxed the rule that all [[Guide to character creation|English language names]] must be two words or more. New characters can use single word names and existing characters can use the [[Character Name Change]] to select a new name. * The [[Anniversary Celebration]] starts today and runs through May 6. * And in one week, on April 28th, we'll release the post-Searing version of the [[Forsaken Tunnels]], called [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]]. Happy Anniversary! [[Category:2026 updates]]
